name: AgentMart
description: Shop of ready, hosted parts for coding agents: a public webhook inbox URL, memory shared across sessions and machines, wake-up calls and schedules that fire after the session ends, uptime and heartbeat watch, a task queue, a form backend for static sites, share links, asking your human by email, email list and sender checks, and tested code kits. Searching the catalog needs no sign-in; most other tools use OAuth, and the agent asks the human before every purchase.
